text:
InfraBot: INCIDENT detected — autoscaler stalled in ap-northeast1 (asia) due to GPU quotaExceeded errors. Queue growth > 6k requests. Paging on-call.
Alice Nguyen: @here getting pages from SLO alert: 99th latency spiking and request queue > 6000. Customers seeing 429s and long tail timeouts. Investigating.
Bob Patel: I’m on it, tailing autoscaler logs now. Seeing repeated errors: `QuotaExceeded: REGION_GPUS_IN_USE quota exceeded for project redwood-prod (code 403)`. Scaling calls return 403.
Carlos Rivera: Confirmed. Autoscaler tried to add 20 nvidia-a100 instances at 09:04:11 UTC and got quota errors. Repeated at 09:04:20, 09:04:45.
Meera Singh: Patch handoff — I’m taking lead for mitigation. On-call rotation: Meera -> Bob -> Tina.
Tina Zhao: Acknowledge. Pulling job queue metrics and customer impact.
SupportBot: Alert summary: ~12 customers report degraded response times, 3 customers report timeouts for >5 minutes. Majority traffic normal but tail is impacted for high-token requests.
Alice Nguyen: Impact estimate: ~4% of production traffic experiencing >10s latencies; high-cost customers on Dedicated unaffected.
Bob Patel: Autoscaler logs (excerpt):
```
2026-03-14T09:04:11Z autoscaler: requesting 20 gpus for pool:inference-ap-northeast1
2026-03-14T09:04:11Z cloud-api: response 403 QuotaExceeded REGION_GPUS_IN_USE
2026-03-14T09:04:20Z autoscaler: retrying request, backoff=2s
2026-03-14T09:04:45Z cloud-api: response 403 QuotaExceeded REGION_GPUS_IN_USE
2026-03-14T09:05:00Z autoscaler: scale stalled, queued_requests=6123
```
Carlos Rivera: Also seeing scheduler throttles: `rate limit exceeded` in our request logs when retries spike.
Meera Singh: Mitigation plan (short term): 1) Reroute new low-latency traffic to eu-west1/us-west2 where capacity exists; 2) Reduce per-request concurrency and drop max tokens for non-critical routes; 3) Activate fallback CPU model for non-SLO workloads; 4) Open cloud quota ticket and call account rep.
Tina Zhao: I can flip routing rules for non-critical customers. Will update feature-flag `region_preference` to prefer us-west2 for new requests.
Bob Patel: Command to verify quotas:
```
gcloud compute regions describe asia-northeast1 --project redwood-prod --format=json | jq '.quotas[] | select(.metric=="GPUS")'
```
Bob Patel: Output shows `limit: 40, usage: 40` for GPU count — we're at limit.
Alice Nguyen: Any spare Dedicated pools we can borrow temporarily? Customers on Dedicated are isolated but we may have spare capacity in internal dev pools.
Carlos Rivera: No spare dedicated capacity in that region. We do have spare in us-west2: ~16 GPUs free.
Meera Singh: Okay Tina — proceed with traffic reroute for non-critical routes to us-west2. We'll keep critical traffic in ap-northeast1 until fallback ready.
Tina Zhao: Pushed config change: `region_preference: [ap-northeast1, us-west2] -> [us-west2, ap-northeast1]` for feature-flagged customers. Rolling change now.
SupportBot: Notifying affected customers: support ticket batch created (TIX-45321). Adding status update to status.redwood.ai.
Alice Nguyen: Please annotate customer-facing message: short note that we're experiencing capacity constraints in ap-northeast1, actively rerouting non-critical requests and working with cloud provider to increase quota. ETA unknown.
Bob Patel: Opening cloud ticket now: `GCP Case 23456789` submitted — subject: "URGENT: REGION_GPUS_IN_USE quota exhausted — request temporary quota increase". Also called account rep; they said they can expedite but need usage justification and expected growth.
Meera Singh: While we wait, enable two more mitigations: A) Enable KV prefix caching aggressively to reduce token generation for heavy sessions. B) Turn on model quantization profile `fast-8bit` for ap-northeast1 to reduce GPU footprint for newer replicas.
Carlos Rivera: Kicking off a rolling config: `service-config apply --region=ap-northeast1 --set=quant_profile=fast-8bit` — starting canary on 10% of new replicas.
Tina Zhao: Canary applied. Monitoring metrics.
Bob Patel: Autoscaler still shows retries but queue is stabilizing at ~4k after routing change. Good sign.
Alice Nguyen: Meera, please handle on-call handoff to Raj at 09:25 UTC for the overnight shift.
Meera Singh: Handoff: current state: ap-northeast1 GPU quota exhausted, queue peak 6.1k, now 3.9k after routing change. GCP case 23456789 opened. Mitigations active: routing, fallback CPU model, quant profile canary, KV caching increased. Next steps: monitor, follow up with GCP, consider cross-region failover if quota not increased within 60-90 minutes.
Raj Malhotra: Taking over. Ping me if anything changes or we need to escalate further.
Tina Zhao: Support update posted to customers with ETA placeholder.
SupportBot: TIX-45321 updated: customers notified; Severity: high; affected routes: generate-text (long-tail) and embeddings for large contexts.
Bob Patel: FYI, a partial workaround attempted: request smaller instances (4x A100 -> 2x A100 and more batch multiplexing) but cloud still enforces GPU count limit so no immediate benefit.
Carlos Rivera: Observability note: add rule to alerts to fire when queue > 2k for >5m so we don't get to this size again.
Alice Nguyen: Also capture the incident timeline for postmortem: initial alarm 09:02 UTC, autoscaler first 403 at 09:04:11, routing flip at 09:10, queue stabilized 09:18, case opened 09:12.
Meera Singh: I'll own postmortem. Assigning to Carlos for quota request follow-ups and Bob for autoscaler retries/backoff tuning.
Raj Malhotra: On-call note: if quota not increased in 90 mins, escalate to multi-region failover and communicate likely prolonged degradation.
SupportBot: Closing interim update — will post final update after GCP responds or when queue <500 and error rate normalized.
Alice Nguyen: Thanks team. Meera/Raj keep monitoring; great work moving fast on mitigations. :thumbsup:
